title: Matched one-dimensional pristine-defect extraction exercise
status_detail: Second manuscript impurity warmup in planning. No planted-defect extraction, finite-size study, reduced model, or observable result has been produced or accepted.
objective: Develop matched one-dimensional pristine and planted-defect supercell exercises with known folding, alignment, extraction, finite-size, model-class, and observable controls.
authorized_scope: Plan null and planted-defect cases whose exact impurity operator and comparison map are known.
Separate supercell folding, basis or gauge alignment, scalar energy-reference alignment, finite-size effects, model-class residuals, and bound-state observables.
Exercise local and controlled nonlocal impurity classes without interpreting them as silicon dopants.
completion_criteria: The null case returns the declared zero extraction after alignment and the planted case recovers the known defect within explicit numerical error.
Alignment, finite-size, reduction, optimization, spectral, wavefunction, and operator errors remain distinct.
Synthetic exercise provenance and limitations are retained without a material-specific or scientific-validation claim.
exclusions: No pristine or doped silicon calculation, impurity interpretation, external execution, or public scientific API stabilization is authorized.
Equal dimensions or labels alone do not establish alignment.
A correct bound-state energy does not establish recovery or transferability of the planted operator.
